name: Date Mizuki
source:
Name: Mizuki Date
Sex: Female
Age: 18
Birthday: July 6
Profession: ABIS Special Agent, Sekiba High Senior, Businesswoman
Like: Aiba, Iris, Metal Pipe, Evolver-MC 
Dislikes: Raw Fish, Porno Mag Collectors
Hobbies: Raising Clione, Collecting Adorabbit Merch
Skills: Beating Up Bad Guys, Motorcycle Riding

Mizuki is ABIS's new Special Agent. A Psyncer who uses the Psync machine to infiltrate the brains of suspects and key witnesses. Mizuki lost her left eye and is now fitted with a replacement eye equipped with advanced artificial intelligence (the AI-Ball "Aiba"). Despite still being a high school student, her strong physical abilities and clever mind have earned her a special accommodation in ABIS.

[From official press release and in-game character description]

[spoiler]It is revealed that Mizuki Date is a clone of Mizuki Kuranushi, and her genes were altered by [url=/c108950]Chikara Horadori[/url], which gives her superhuman strength.[/spoiler]
